claire: Quick repro: sample-edge fails after export-map change. Browser shows 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' and editors resolve types to CJS d.ts. Also two /v1/token requests.
dom: paste package.json exports?
claire: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" }
ravi: Classic bundler/HMR issue. Bundler resolves import condition but wraps modules for dev, mixing .mjs into CJS wrapper -> parse error. Duplicate token likely two SDK instances (esm + cjs) or double init.
claire: Workaround: explicit import in sample: `import { Redwood } from 'redwood-js-sdk/dist/esm/edge.mjs'` fixes both. Not ideal.
dom: Plan: 1) make init idempotent (guard promise), 2) ship small `dist/esm/edge.mjs` entry and update samples/docs, 3) add edge smoke CI.
docs-bot: Created RDW-5788 (labels: devex, sdk-exports, edge, types)
claire: I'll open PR to docs with explicit import and repro steps. Ravi will prototype init guard.
